name: [Portal] Store access: move the shop list to its own page and match the Figma design
description:
## Summary

 (PR [#44054](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/44054)) shipped the partner's shop list on the Partner Portal root page (`PartnerPortalOverview`) as an account list: E-shop ID, E-shop, E-mail, Last login. The Figma frame „Vstup do obchodů" shows something different. It is a dedicated page under its own menu item „Obchody", with one row per e-shop (Název e-shopu, Doména), a „Přejít do obchodu" button that opens that shop's admin in a new tab, and the partner's own test shop listed first. This task moves the list to its own page and aligns the UI and the row semantics with the design. The portal root is freed for the future „Základní přehled". The branded portal shell (top bar, four-item sidebar) is out of scope and is covered by the portal layout tasks.

## Why?

The current page doesn't match the approved design. Partners can't see their own test shop, and one shop shows up several times when they reach it through several e-mails.

## What?

A new portal page „Vstup do obchodů" with its own menu item „Obchody", one level under the existing „Portál partnera" row. Slugs: `vstup-do-obchodu` (cs), `vstup-do-obchodov` (sk), `shop-access` (en), `belepes-az-uzletekbe` (hu), `shop-zugang` (de). Page content per Figma: breadcrumbs, H1, subtitle, three-column table.

## Acceptance Criteria

The list lives on its own page with menu item „Obchody" and H1 „Vstup do obchodů". The menu label and the H1 are intentionally different.

The portal root no longer shows the list.

Breadcrumbs (home › Vstup do obchodů) and the subtitle text from Figma are shown.

Columns: Název e-shopu, Doména (clickable URL), an action column with the „Přejít do obchodu" button.

One row per e-shop, even if the partner reaches it through several e-mail accounts.

The partner's own test shop is included and listed first.

„Přejít do obchodu" opens that e-shop's admin in a new tab. Without a session there, the shop's admin login is shown.

The page stays gated by the partnerPortal module. The existing empty state stays.

Page and menu item translated in cs, sk, en, hu, de.

## Open questions

- Q1: Design note: placement may change after alpha if API partners use their test shop very often. Keep as is for now?
- Q2: Do we drop E-mail and Last login completely, or does someone still need them?

## Resources

- Figma: [Store access section 649:42692](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=649-42692&m=dev), [page frame 739:11678](https://www.figma.com/design/uyNyEpBk6MYXqjXprmXftl/Partner-Portal?node-id=739-11678&m=dev)

## Technical notes

- Current code: `admin/controllers/PartnerPortal/PartnerPortalOverviewController.php`, `frontend/apps/admin-web/src/PartnerPortal/pages/PartnerPortalOverview/page.tsx`
- Data: `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Infrastructure/Persistence/Account/Repository/PartnerAccountReadRepository.php` excludes the current project (`projectId != current`) and returns e-mail × project rows.
- The menu row is a new `cms2_admin_section_map` row under the „Portál partnera" parent (see migration CZ3TDR1-542). `cms2_admin_section_map_lng` has UNIQUE (language, indexName), so slugs share one global namespace per language.
